early_timings: before-gl/candidate-gl used an earlier source/asset revision with old private prepared caches. Retained as exploration, superseded by the verified matched rows.
snapshot: A full private refresh copied prepared resources as well as source geometry. A subsequent guarded refresh rejected changing prepared inputs; its stable retry accepted. No frozen binary was published to live.
concurrent_sources: A concurrent CarVisual lazy-factory change exposed untyped window-radius arguments. A narrow attempted production patch found that its author had already fixed them, so this task made no vehicle-source mutation. Later Electric contour assertions were corrected by copying the concurrent author's updated two helpers into the private fixture. Both copies are recorded.
counter_probe: Initial native primitive-counter calls had an incomplete/reversed argument list and did not force every static preview redraw. Those observations are rejected; corrected probes expose the real lack of active LODs in guarded source fallback.
lod_readiness: The initial fifteen-percent aggregate triangle gate fails on current source fallback. That qualification remains explicitly unavailable. The functional fixture labels it unqualified, rather than bypassing cache guards or generating LODs at runtime. A separate stored Compact control measures the actual native distance-level policy.
broad_app_timeout: The first equipped-cache App fixture timed out after APP_READY with stable inputs. A traced repeat completes 45 assertions cleanly with the same runtime implementation; the timeout is not claimed as a deterministic new regression.
startup_fixture: The old fixture expected startup to wait for an equipped picture, but the current App intentionally publishes the first menu before optional captures. Its 100-second Garage idle delay also blocked header admission. The updated fixture suppresses optional Garage processing without extending the shared idle threshold, observes eventual image readiness, and retains zero wrong-stock frames. Idle account checks release text focus in the fixture; production input gates are unchanged.
harness: One startup invocation hit argparse's trailing positional delimiter handling before engine launch. Explicit fixture environment arguments now avoid that ambiguity. An initial nested PowerShell command expanded its pipeline variable in the outer shell; the dependency check then ran through a literal -File script.
checkpoint: Original staged-preparation fixtures use CRLF. Per-command CRLF-aware whitespace checks preserve real whitespace checks. A standalone no-repository scratch apply avoids repository eol conversion and proves exact forward/reverse bytes; live reverse check still uses repository attributes. No repository Git configuration or main-index write.
